name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: Smooth SVG trend with a scrubbable marker, value tooltip, and size tones. No Recharts.

props.name: data
props.description: Series values plotted left to right

props.name: interactive
props.description: Scrub the marker with pointer or arrow keys

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the numeric value in the floating tooltip

props.name: size
props.description: Plot height for inline, card, or hero use

props.name: tone
props.description: Stroke and fill color from semantic tokens

ai.purpose: Show a quiet, scrubbable trend with a marker and optional value.
preferOver: AreaChart when you do not need axes, legends, or multiple series
compositions: Sparkline under a metric and Badge
